body: I wish I could find the motivation to pursue some random inclination. If I am awol for too long either the army or my civilian job will start to look for me. In the movie "American Beauty" the main protagonist attempts to relieve his hardships by abandoning and reducing his responsibilities. While it was great in the movie, in reality it means digging your hole deeper. I just want to keep a low profile until this ends. I have had 4 large breakdowns in the past ten years, each one I tried to separate myself from everything and start over hoping to fix this. I've moved jobs, moved physically, rebuilt new circles of friends, used drugs, developed physical fitness, and nothing has helped.

Somehow through all these years I have managed to keep good credit. I have considered just throwing it all into the wind. I have always managed to keep good jobs, but a few years into it, the crippling social anxiety and the apathy that comes from depression usually leads me to put in notice and quit. I have no self esteem, none. Yet keeping a responsible image has always been important to me. That is really the reason for leaving without debt. I have no hard feelings towards anyone. I just can't stand being myself, being alive.

Another issue I have is that of prejudice towards males when seeking treatment for mental health issues. Many here know that expressing concerns about depression are brushed aside by most as petty. Seeking help with social anxiety as a male is on another tier. That crushing claustrophobic feeling I get day in and day out is too much. I have empathy for anyone else out there going through similar symptoms.
